lines.en: Not tall, but I move fast.
Sword on my back, my step is light.

lines.zh: 我踩着小碎步穿过空地。
lines.en: Quick short steps across the clearing.
Ki under my feet pushes me along.
A boy's steps are always hurried.
I walk and scan around at once.

lines.zh: 鞋子踩到石子，我跳过去。
lines.en: Hit a pebble, so I hop over it.
Small I may be, but my legs are quick.
Half a circle around him.

lines.zh: 背包带子滑下来，我拽回去。
lines.en: The strap slid off — I pull it back.

lines.zh: 前面有台阶，我一步跨两层。
lines.en: Stairs ahead. Two steps at a time.
This body is light as wind.

lines.zh: 我抱着剑站着，等你先动。
lines.en: Holding my sword, waiting for you to move.
This sword is a little taller than me.
Wondering what Mother would say.
Licking my lips. Bit thirsty.
I'm still not good at holding my ki in.

lines.zh: 这地方跟我那儿差很多。
lines.en: This place is very different from mine.
Counting clouds overhead.
These calluses came from sword practice.
Standing a while and my legs ache.
I wipe down the scabbard.

lines.zh: 远处有声音，我竖起耳朵。
lines.en: A sound far off — I listen.

lines.zh: 这身衣服是未来的款式。
lines.en: These clothes are from the future.

lines.zh: 我不想让人看出我紧张。
lines.en: I don't want them to see I'm nervous.
Are you here to help me?

lines.zh: 你的气，和我父亲的很像。
lines.en: Your ki resembles my father's.
What should I call you?

lines.zh: 你见过一个紫色头发的女人吗？
lines.en: Have you seen a woman with purple hair?
Don't worry, I don't draw for nothing.

lines.zh: 你站在那里像在等我说话。
lines.en: You stand there like you're waiting for me.

lines.zh: 我不是小孩子，别小看我。
lines.en: I'm not a child. Don't underestimate me.
You're bleeding.

lines.zh: 我可以帮你，也可以跟你打。
lines.en: I can help you, or fight you.
Is this area safe?
Sword calluses — you've trained?
Talk first. Then we'll see.

lines.zh: 我闻到烟味了，附近有人。
lines.en: I smell smoke. Someone's nearby.

lines.zh: 别站在我背后，我会紧张。
lines.en: Don't stand behind me. I get jumpy.
What are you smiling at? Did I say something?

lines.zh: 我们也许可以一起走一段。
lines.en: Maybe we can walk a while together.
It hurts. I'll bear it.
Wind ruffles my purple hair; I stand straight.
The back of my hand's gone red.
Teeth clenched. I'm still up.
Blood running down my arm.
Almost dropped my sword.
Don't worry. I'm all right.
The blow left my ears ringing.
A few more of those and I'm done.
Food? I'm not picky at all.
That smells really good.
I haven't had anything hot in ages.
Just give me half.
I'll eat and keep watch.
Did you make this yourself?
Don't put too much salt in it.
I eat fast. Don't be surprised.
Got any boiled hot water?
My hands are full with the sword.
Oops, bumped you. Sorry.
I'm small. Easy to bump into.
You're blocking my line.
A bit left and I can pass.
Don't shove me, my sword'll fall.
Half a step apart solves it.
Your shoulder's way above mine.
I'll step back. You go first.
No harm done. Relax.
We'll be stepping on each other.
I'm too young for that.
That can wait till later.
My head's full of other things.
That came out of nowhere.

lines.zh: 我连自己的路都没走完。
lines.en: I haven't even finished my own road.
Talk about it when there's peace.
Don't tease me with that.
Am I blushing? Can you tell?
I haven't thought that far.
Cloth on the ground — picking it up.
This coin looks new.
Picked up some crumbs of rations.
This branch is good for practice.
Don't pick that up. Dangerous.
My pockets are full.
Slipping it into my pack.
Let it go. Don't chase it.
Here — you dropped this.
Something's moving over there!
I see it. Quiet.
This one means trouble. I'm ready.
I go first. You follow.
Ki is gathering this way.
I can close that distance.
He's armed. Not a passerby.
I've already drawn the sword.
Stay calm. I can see it clearly.
He's up high. He'll strike first.
Target marked. Don't let him run.
Let me test him first.
No one's stopping me now.
I sink my ki to my feet; here I come.
He's fast. Not as fast as me.
Timing his strike.
There's a gap in his stance.
Ki at my soles, ready to launch.
He circles. So do I.
Wait a moment. Let him rush.
He switched hands — there's my chance.
No recklessness. Read the flaw.
He retreats. I advance.
I can cut in from this angle.
He looks like he's calling for help.
The ground here is slick.
Gathering ki into my hands.
Not yet. Half a beat.
He won't expect someone this short.
I watch his feet, not his hands.
This has to land in one go.
My sword's here — take it!
I dart in. Quick as that.
This cut comes down from above!
Half strength on this one.
Rapping your wrist with the flat.
Ki blast — a bit off target.
Kick your knee, then break off.
The seam in your armor is on the side.
Small enough to slip inside.
One more cut, with effort.
Father taught me this one.
Don't just stand there blocking.
I twist and add another cut.
You got one. Here's mine.
Wobbled there — almost lost my grip.
Strike and pull back. No lingering.

lines.zh: 我从半空落下来，脚先着地。
lines.en: Down from the air, feet first.

lines.zh: 这身衣服，是从未来带来的。
lines.en: These clothes came from the future.

lines.zh: 我背着剑站在空地中间。
lines.en: I stand in the clearing, sword on my back.
Everything here is unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 我落地时扬起一小片灰。
lines.en: A little dust puffs up where I land.
Someone called my name? I look up.
I undo the clasp on the scabbard.

lines.zh: 先看看方向，再决定走哪。
lines.en: Check the landmarks, then choose.
Ki settled. Feet set.
I don't know this place well yet.
The sword's awkward on my back.
I'm here. Mother isn't.
This sky's color is strange.
Almost slipped on landing.
Someone's over there. Let me look.
I fix my cuff and walk on.

lines.zh: 我从未来赶来，落在草地上。
lines.en: I've come from the future, landing on grass.
I push my ki down.
My sleeve's burning — I slap it out.
Water up my nose. Awful.
The blast threw me several paces.

lines.zh: 一枚东西擦过我的耳朵。
lines.en: Something grazed my ear.
Spellcraft circles around me.
My empty stomach shakes.
Lightning struck — I went stiff.
Falling, and I can't shout.
